source.frontend_working_tree_at_build: Clean at the specified commit; later unrelated geometry edits are not in this copied fixed bundle.
source.bundle: Local npm run build PASS (vue-tsc and Vite, 277 modules); copied fixed bundle, not a trusted release artifact.
source.backend_provenance: Local Go binary was built from the earlier ba38bb3 checkout; git diff --quiet confirms backend sources identical between ba38bb3 and 4ce70a7. This is not a trusted deployed binary.

fixture.scope: Disposable local Go/PostgreSQL schema and private attachment directory; three synthetic accounts, one shared TEXT channel and one two-participant DM. No production data or LiveKit.
fixture.browser: Installed Chrome headless CLI with isolated profiles and same-origin synthetic login; no session cookie or token in browser arguments, URL, logs or evidence. No remote debugging was used.
fixture.file_selection_method: Browser-side DataTransfer assigned synthetic File objects to the real TEXT/DM input.files and dispatched change. The visible attach trigger was clicked separately with input.click instrumented; this did not select a system file.
fixture.storage: Local attachment volume had ample headroom; no attempt was made to fill or alter it to force a real 507.

checks.name: visible_attach_trigger
checks.detail: TEXT and DM visible + buttons each invoked their hidden file input click once. Native operating-system file chooser and physical file selection were NOT_RUN in headless CLI.

checks.name: text_upload_ui
checks.detail: A 25,000,001-byte File was rejected by client validation without upload; pending label rendered during a delayed response; injected HTTP 507 showed error; re-selecting the same synthetic PNG made a real POST return 201; sending bound the file to a TEXT message; authenticated download and normalized preview returned 200.

checks.name: dm_upload_ui
checks.detail: The same over-limit and delayed pending checks passed; injected HTTP 507 exposed the DM retry button; clicking retry made a real POST return 201; sending bound the file to a DM message; authenticated download and normalized PNG preview returned 200.

checks.name: dm_private_file_acl
checks.detail: The sender and the second participant each received 200 for protected download and preview. The second participant received 128 source bytes, attachment disposition, no-store and nosniff headers; preview was image/png with no-store and nosniff. A third guild member received 404 for both URLs and the DM was absent from its navigation API list.

checks.name: database_and_filesystem
checks.detail: Five small successful uploads were ATTACHED and linked (two TEXT, three DM); zero UNATTACHED rows and zero staging files. Failed client-limit and injected-507 attempts did not create attachment rows.

checks.name: native_file_chooser
checks.detail: Chrome headless CLI provides no supported physical file-selection interaction in this packet; the DataTransfer run is not evidence that a person selected a file in the operating-system chooser.

checks.name: real_server_507
checks.detail: The 507 was injected into browser fetch to test UI recovery. The real server's low-headroom path was not exercised on the healthy local volume.

artifact_policy: PNG files are local-only in ignored evidence/design/artifacts/ and were not staged; the JSON contains no message body, credential, session token or DM identifier.
cleanup: The release preview and local API were stopped; ports 18775 and 18089 were verified idle. The exact disposable PostgreSQL schema qa05upload_4ce70a7 was dropped and verified absent. Synthetic attachment files, harness files and isolated Chrome profiles remain in TEMP; filesystem deletion was not retried after an earlier automatic review rejected exact-file removal as blocked by policy. PNGs remain ignored and unstaged.
remaining_gate: QA-05 and DES-02 remain open: exercise a real system file chooser/selection in an allowed browser environment, verify a real low-headroom 507 without filling production storage, and complete the remaining browser/screen-reader acceptance criteria.
